Example Calculation Below is a worked example for several freighter aircraft at max ramp weight, assuming:  Tractor mass 𝑚 =50,000kg 𝑡𝑢𝑔  Distance D=150 m  Rolling friction coefficient f=0.006  Speed 𝑣=1.5 m/s → rolling time ≈ 100 s  Regeneration 𝜂 =25% 𝑟𝑒𝑔𝑒𝑛  Overhead power 𝑃 =20 kW 𝑎𝑢𝑥  Total operation time (hook-up + push) ≈4 min=0.0667 h  Drivetrain efficiency 𝜂 =75% 𝑑𝑟𝑖𝑣𝑒 Aircraft Weights (examples):  A300-600F: ~170 t  B747-400F: ~396 t  B747-8F: ~448 t  B757-200F: ~115 t 36  B767-200F: ~159 t  B767-300F: ~187 t  B777F: ~347 t  MD-11F: ~286 t Including 50 t tractor, we get total masses from 165 t to nearly 500 t.
